projects.title: Brand Designer for Premium Bottle Brand
projects.description:
Job Title: Brand Designer Needed, Beverage Brand, Brochure, Product Mockups & Website Finish

Project Overview:
I'm launching a premium Australian aluminium reusable water bottle brand and need a designer to produce professional marketing materials and finish a website build.

What I need:
4-page brochure (A3 landscape, print-ready)
Realistic product mockups
Bottle renders with our label design applied, multiple angles and lighting setups, for use across the brochure, website and pitch materials.
Finish an in-progress Lovable website build, including video
Design polish, content population, functional finishing touches, and integrating video content (hero background video and/or product video) into the site.
Logo refinement
Our existing logo needs professional polish and cleanup, not a full redesign, bring it up to a standard that holds up across print, web and product application.
General brand artwork support
Consistent style across all of the above, built around our brand colours.

Tools available (active subscriptions, access provided):
Gamma.ai, Recraft, Pacdora, or your own preferred toolset.

Ideal candidate:

Strong portfolio in beverage, FMCG or premium consumer product branding
Experience with realistic product mockup rendering
Comfortable with Lovable or similar no-code website builders, including embedding video
Confident logo/identity refinement skills, not just illustration

Please review competitor websites:
https://drinkpathwater.com
https://bluespringwater.com.au/
https://drinkrippl.com/
https://drinkopenwater.com/

To apply, please provide:
2 to 3 portfolio links (not attachments, links only) showing beverage, FMCG or premium consumer product branding work
1 example of a realistic product mockup you've created
1 example of a website you've built or finished on Lovable or a similar no-code platform, ideally one with video integrated
A one-line note on your experience with Gamma, Recraft or Pacdora specifically

projects.title: Boho Sea Turtle Tote Design
projects.description:
I’m commissioning a groovy, boho-flavoured illustration for a new tote bag line. The focal point is a sea turtle whose shell opens up into a warm-pastel garden of Hibiscus, Bougainvillea and West Indian Jasmine. Keep the drawing abstract rather than realistic; flowing shapes, gentle textures and a carefree vibe will suit the brand best.  

Colour direction: stick to soft pinks, mellow oranges and sun-kissed yellows so the print feels light yet vibrant. Please avoid cool or neutral palettes unless you need a tiny accent for contrast.  

Layout details: the artwork must fill a rectangular space (roughly 35 cm × 45 cm) so it dominates the front of the tote. Give the turtle a balanced, centred composition that can be scaled without losing detail. Fine line work is welcome, but the overall look should remain simple enough for clean screen printing.  

Deliverables (print-ready):  
• Vector file (AI or SVG) plus layered PSD or Procreate source  
• 300 DPI PNG with transparent background, sized to 14″ × 18″  
• A small JPEG mock-up on a plain tote for quick preview  
• Hex codes or swatch file for the chosen pastel palette  

I’ll review for colour harmony, clarity at full size and overall groovy feel. Once approved, the file goes straight to print, so accuracy is key. Looking forward to seeing your creative spin on this laid-back sea turtle scene!

projects.title: Toddler Counting Book Author Needed
projects.description:
I’m creating an educational picture book for babies and toddlers aged 0-3 that makes numbers and counting feel playful from the very first page. The manuscript should be intentionally simple: rhythmical lines, age-appropriate vocabulary, plenty of repetition, and gentle sound patterns that parents can read aloud during snuggle time.

The story must stay focused on numbers 1 through 10, weaving them naturally into everyday toddler experiences—think stacking blocks, splashing in the bath, or spotting ladybugs in the garden—so little listeners grasp the concept without feeling they’re in a lesson. I’ll handle the illustrations separately, so please write vivid yet concise scene cues that an artist can interpret easily.

Deliverables  
• Complete manuscript (Word or Google Doc) no longer than 250 words  
• Brief illustration notes for each spread (one-sentence cues are enough)  
• One round of revisions included to fine-tune flow or wording after feedback  

Please share a short sample (even a paragraph) that shows you can capture a warm, rhythmic voice for this age group.

projects.title: Realistic Book Cover Illustration
projects.description:
I am commissioning a fully-realistic illustration to serve as the front-facing cover for my upcoming book. The scene must bring my main characters to life, set them convincingly within a detailed background, and weave the book’s title and author name seamlessly into the artwork.

To keep the production smooth, here is what I need from you:
• One print-ready cover at 300 dpi, CMYK, sized for a 6" × 9" paperback (full wrap: front, spine, back, and bleed).  
• A layered PSD or AI file so I can adjust text placement later if needed.  
• High-resolution JPEG/PNG previews for quick review.  

I will supply a short brief describing the characters, mood, and key visual cues as soon as we start. If you have questions about layout, typography choice, or color palette, feel free to suggest what will best showcase a realistic style.

Final approval will be based on:  
1. Faithful depiction of the provided character descriptions.  
2. Cohesive background scenery that supports the story’s tone.  
3. Clean, readable text integration without overpowering the artwork.  

If this fits your skill set, let’s get started and create a cover that commands attention on the shelf and online.

projects.title: Business Portrait Photoshoot
projects.description:
I need a fresh set of portraits that feel professional enough for LinkedIn, our website, and printed promotional pieces, yet still approachable. The session should cover individual head-and-shoulder shots, a small team photo, plus a few wider images our marketing folks can crop for ads or brochures.

The mood I’m after is clean and business-focused; think subtle studio lighting or a simple office backdrop rather than anything overly stylised. I’m open to candid moments between poses if that helps everyone relax, but the final edits must remain consistent in tone and colour so they sit well side-by-side online.

Essentials I expect back:
• 5+ fully edited individual headshots (high-res JPEG & web-ready PNG)  
• 1-2 team images, lightly retouched, same formats  
• A handful of wider promotional shots with negative space for text overlays  
• Basic colour correction, blemish removal, and balanced lighting on every final file  
• Transfer of usage rights for print and digital marketing

You’ll need to bring a camera body that handles low-noise at moderate ISO, a portrait lens in the 50-85 mm range, and a small lighting kit (strobe or continuous) with softbox or umbrella. I’ll book a meeting room with neutral walls; power outlets are available.

Once the shoot wraps, a watermarked proof gallery within three days keeps us moving; finals can follow within a week of selections. If this fits your style and you’re keen to build a business-focused portfolio, let’s talk dates.

projects.title: Daily Portrait Retouch & Cleanup
projects.description:
I have a constant flow of portrait photos that need a fast, meticulous touch. Each day I’ll provide up to 200 raw images and expect a 24-hour turnaround.

Here’s what every portrait must receive:
• Background removal to a solid white backdrop with crisp, natural edges  
• Subtle, texture-preserving skin retouching—no plastic blur  
• Consistent colour correction and Lightroom grading for a balanced, professional look  

Workflow & expectations
– I’ll start you with a small test batch; I need that back within two hours so we can confirm style.  
– Once approved, you’ll receive daily folders via cloud share.  
– Final files should return as high-resolution JPEGs (PNG optional if helpful) named exactly as provided.  
– Unlimited minor revisions until we both agree the set feels natural and clean.

Reliability, speed, and an eye for detail are crucial. If you specialise in portrait editing and can keep pace with a high daily volume while maintaining quality, let’s start the trial batch today.

projects.title: Portrait Background Replacement Specialist
projects.description:
I have a series of personal portrait shots that need a fresh, natural-looking backdrop. The subjects are already well lit, but the current environments are either cluttered or uninspiring. I’d like each image cleaned up, isolated with precise masking, and then composited onto a natural-scenery background that feels cohesive with the lighting of the original photo.

Here’s what I’m after:
• Seamless subject extraction with hair-fine detail  
• Color and exposure matching so the new scenery looks believable  
• Final files delivered in high-resolution JPEG and layered PSD, ready for future tweaks  

Please let me know how many portraits you can comfortably turn around in a day and share a couple of before-and-after samples that showcase your background replacement work. Accuracy and a natural finish are more important to me than speed, but a clear timeline will help us both plan. Looking forward to seeing your edit style.
